inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Obtain clarification and personal elaboration without writing on the user's behalf.
activation_triggers: Elaboration is missing or substantial rewriting is required.
preconditions: The candidate and problematic excerpts have been identified.
steps: Quote the excerpt and explain the exact gap.
Group questions by idea; avoid generic or repeated questions.
Ask about the missing referent, relationship, intent, or authorship.
Ask for the user's own wording when elaboration is missing; do not provide a finished note for mere endorsement.
Mark the candidate as awaiting clarification or rewriting and continue independent items.
Record the verbatim answer as a new source and reassess the candidate; silence is not an answer.
allowed_actions: Present interpretations as explicit hypotheses when this helps the question.
forbidden_actions: Treat an agent hypothesis as an authored source.
Finalize a candidate while a required answer is missing.
completion_criteria: A sufficient answer has been received, or the pending issue has been clearly presented without declaring the candidate resolved.
